title: DevoSamples-ps Catalog
description: Machine-readable index emitted by tools/Build-Catalog.ps1. Consumers (agents) filter by effective_status to find scripts compatible with the current Devolutions product version.

product_versions.description: Snapshot of tools/product-versions.psd1 at catalog generation time.

sha.description: Git blob SHA of the file content.

effective_status.description: Computed by Build-Catalog: 'stale' when tested_up_to falls below current product version; 'legacy' for files outside src/; otherwise mirrors declared status.

frontmatter.description: Raw front matter as declared in the file (omitted for legacy files without front matter).
